title: Global additive Cech augmentation quasi-isomorphism
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], finite open cover U, and injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], there exists a chain map from additiveCechGlobal I to additiveCechTotal U I whose degree-n component is additiveCechAlpha U I n [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], and this map is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: Use zariski_to_etale_core to obtain an inclusion j which forgets to X.restrictFunctor and preserves finite limits and covers. The canonical additiveCechOpenInclusion has the same forgetful composite; fullyFaithfulCancelRight gives a natural isomorphism to j. Transfer finite-limit preservation and continuity, then use isContinuous_iff_coverPreserving to obtain cover preservation. Preservation of terminal objects makes its value at top terminal.

Construct restriction-zero by the product of the maps from each tuple intersection to the identity etale object. Naturality of a resolution differential proves that these form a map a to Cech degree zero. The two degree-zero Cech cofaces become equal after composing to the terminal identity object; their alternating sum is zero, proving a followed by the horizontal differential is zero.

Construct b by following each component of a by the (0,n) total inclusion. The total differential identities give one zero horizontal term and the vertical resolution term with sign +1, proving the chain-map equation. Its components are definitionally additiveCechAlpha.

For each injective resolution term, precompose its single-object augmentation by the isomorphism on sections induced by the unique isomorphism between the terminal open-inclusion object and the identity etale object. The degree-zero projections are the usual open restrictions: both composite site maps have terminal codomain, hence agree. Apply etaleOpenCechInjectiveAugmentation_quasiIso; cancel the precomposed isomorphism using quasiIso_iff_comp_left.

Apply quasiIso_of_column_augmentation to a, its zero horizontal differential, b, the defining component equality, and the preceding row quasi-isomorphisms. This proves QuasiIso b and supplies the required existential witness. No nonempty-cover hypothesis was used; empty or repeated intersections and the empty cover remain included.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmentation alpha; explicit restriction and total-differential calculations adapted from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleOpenCechResolutionTotal

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAdditiveCech_alpha_quasiIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) :
    ∃ a : additiveCechGlobal I ⟶ additiveCechTotal U I,
      (∀ n : ℕ, a.f n = additiveCechAlpha U I n) ∧ QuasiIso a
